Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Iris Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only
· At 1.5 T: Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4-W/kg; head SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg; Scan for up to 60 minutes
· At 3 T: B1+rms <= 1.2 uT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 0.5 W/kg; No more than 15 minutes of active scan time per session
· Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Iris Embolization Coil System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
